name: Argonne Middle School Electric Car Competition
what_you_do: Your middle school team builds a small electric car and races it at Argonne. Cars run several heats, the fastest go to a final, and judges also score creative design.
who_can_apply: Teams of 3 to 5 middle school students from the same school. The coach must be a teacher or administrator there. Up to two teams per school, first come, first served.
pay_detail: The page does not say if there is a cost.
duration: Build over the winter, race on one Saturday
deadline_text: 2026 team sign-up closed Jan 16, 2026, and the race was Mar 14, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Ask a teacher to coach a team and register it on the competition page.
notes: A good start for ages 12 to 14 before the high school Autonomous Vehicle Competition. Each year has a handbook on the page.
